result:
I added a **Resend Pending Invitations** operation to the Member resource of the Bitwarden node. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **Operation list:** the new option is in `descriptions/MemberDescription.ts`. Its value is `resendInvitations`.
- **Pending members:** `Bitwarden.node.ts` fetches `/public/members` and keeps the members with status `0`. I took status `0` to mean "invited" from my knowledge of the Bitwarden API. I did not check it against the API docs.
- **Resend:** each pending member gets a `POST /public/members/{id}/reinvite`. I also took this endpoint from memory and did not check it.
- **Output:** one item per member, in the form `{ email, success }`. If one resend fails, that member gets `success: false` and the others still run. The API error message is not kept in the item.
- **No pending members:** the node throws a `NodeOperationError` that says "The organization has no members with a pending invitation".
- **Input items:** the operation works on the whole organization, so it runs once for the first input item. It skips the other items, so it does not send duplicate invitations.

I used an `as` cast on the members response, which `packages/nodes-base/AGENTS.md` discourages. The other operations in this node do the same. I also did not add `continueOnFail` support. I added no test or schema file.
